lineages.name: 불균형 거신
lineages.theme: Scale load deforms a bulky two-legged statue. Always EXACTLY TWO arms and TWO legs; one arm can become far larger, but both remain clearly rooted. One greatsword held in one or both hands, exactly two scale pans on rear beam. Strong diagonal unequal mass.

lineages.name: 공허의 판결체
lineages.theme: Opening blindfold/mask and rib shell turn a two-legged judging statue into a giant hollow judicial mouth/face-cage. Always EXACTLY TWO arms and TWO legs. No realistic biological mouth/teeth or human expression; serrated porcelain slabs, hinges and black voids. One sword, two balance pans, original blindfold fragment.

lineages.name: 재판소 융합체
lineages.theme: Body fuses with tribunal throne and balance apparatus; mobile statue body progressively becomes a monstrous moving judicial reliquary. Tiers1-2 two arms/two legs; tiers3-5 EXACTLY FOUR support legs and TWO execution arms, with all roots/joints clearly visible. One greatsword, two pans and blindfolded mask remnant.
